description: This file is a JavaScript plugin for Leaflet that adds drawing and editing tools to maps, including classes and methods for creating, editing, and deleting map layers such as polylines, polygons, circles, rectangles, and markers.

classes.name: L.Draw.Feature
classes.description: Base class for drawing features on the map, handles enabling/disabling drawing modes.

classes.name: L.Draw.Polyline
classes.description: Class for drawing polylines, supports adding vertices, deleting last vertex, and finishing shape.

classes.name: L.Draw.Polygon
classes.description: Class for drawing polygons, extends polyline with area calculation and shape validation.

classes.name: L.Draw.SimpleShape
classes.description: Base class for simple shape drawing (rectangle, circle), manages shape creation and finalization.

classes.name: L.Draw.Rectangle
classes.description: Class for drawing rectangles, sets bounds based on start and current point.

classes.name: L.Draw.Circle
classes.description: Class for drawing circles, manages radius based on mouse movement.

classes.name: L.Draw.Marker
classes.description: Class for placing markers on the map.

classes.name: L.Edit
classes.description: Namespace for editing handlers.

classes.name: L.Edit.Poly
classes.description: Handler for editing polygon/polyline vertices.

classes.name: L.Edit.SimpleShape
classes.description: Handler for editing simple shapes like rectangle and circle.

classes.name: L.Edit.Rectangle
classes.description: Handler for editing rectangle bounds and corners.

classes.name: L.Edit.Circle
classes.description: Handler for editing circle radius and position.

classes.name: L.Edit.Toolbar
classes.description: Toolbar for editing and deleting features.

classes.name: L.EditToolbar
classes.description: Toolbar class for managing edit and delete modes.

classes.name: L.EditToolbar.Edit
classes.description: Handler for editing features.

classes.name: L.EditToolbar.Delete
classes.description: Handler for deleting features.

classes.name: L.Control.Draw
classes.description: Map control for toggling drawing and editing tools.

classes.name: L.Toolbar
classes.description: Base class for toolbars, manages mode handlers and actions.

classes.name: L.Tooltip
classes.description: Class for displaying tooltips during drawing/editing.

classes.name: L.DrawToolbar
classes.description: Toolbar for drawing modes (polyline, polygon, rectangle, circle, marker).

classes.name: L.EditToolbar
classes.description: Toolbar for editing and deleting features.
